SAFETY_NOTES: Hydration: minimum 3.0–3.5 litres of water daily. On 24h+ fasts add a pinch of Himalayan pink salt every 3–4 hours to prevent headaches and cramps.
Refeeding: never break an extended fast (24h/36h/48h) with heavy carbs, fried food or sugar. Warm water + lemon/ghee first, then broth, soup or curd after 30 minutes.
Coach override: any day's window can be adjusted from the admin panel if a client has extreme fatigue, illness or travel conflicts.

PHASE_GOALS.Phase 1 — Foundation & Adaptation: Establish routine baseline, control hunger spikes, and transition into a structured 14-hour fasting schedule.
PHASE_GOALS.Phase 2 — Deep Intermittent Fasting: Accelerate fat adaptation, lower resting insulin levels, and achieve a steady 18/6 fasting ratio.
PHASE_GOALS.Phase 3 — Narrow Window & Autophagy Prep: Master 20/4 and 21/3 windows to prepare the body for full 24-hour extended fasts.
PHASE_GOALS.Phase 4 — 24-Hour Fasting Integration: Trigger deep cellular autophagy with alternate 24-hour fasts and structured 18/6 refeed days.
PHASE_GOALS.Phase 5 — Extended Fasting Progression: Maximize metabolic repair, fat loss, and peak discipline through 36-hour and 48-hour extended fasting protocols.
PHASE_GOALS.Phase 6 — Mastery & Long-Term Exit: Consolidate metabolic gains, stabilize hormone levels, and exit into a sustainable 16/8 lifestyle routine.
